title: Indexing after dropping a list prefix
statement: For every Boolean list $y$ and natural numbers $a,i$, the element at index $i$ of the list obtained by dropping the first $a$ entries of $y$, using false as the default when the index is out of range, equals the element of $y$ at index $a+i$ with the same default.
